_note: Loop 1 crossings (placeholder, Tim to tune). Drawing only: walking is decided by world.json fords + rules.fordRadius. Kept out of world_paint.json because the atlas registration hashes that file. Merged into the paint settings in src/main.js.

fordBed._note: Gravel bar painted into the river bed at each of the 8 fords (units). along = half length of the bar along the river; across follows the painted water width plus bankMargin (at least acrossMin); solid = share kept fully gravel before the ragged edge fades; waterLevel = water mask over the bar (0.455 hides water, 0.545 full water); mix = bed materials blended in patches (patchScale units, patchWidth blend softness); shallow = strength of the clear shallow-water look.

ford._note: Overrides world_paint.json ford (replaces the whole object): size of the river_ford stepping-stone art in world units, shrunk from 70 to 14 (Tim: 80% smaller), and the widest river that gets stones.

bridge._note: Plain plank strip across the river at each of the 9 bridges (units). overhang = extra length past each edge of the painted water.
